result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical broken elements. However, there are minor layout and content truncation issues, specifically with the 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name being cut off in the horizontal scroll section.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section, making it unclear what the full name is.
issues.suggestion: Either allow the text to wrap to a second line, use an ellipsis with a tooltip on hover/long-press, or ensure the card width accommodates the full name.

issues.description: The horizontal scrollable category pills (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appear to be cut off on the right edge, suggesting there are more categories not immediately visible without scrolling, but there is no visual cue indicating this.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade or arrow indicator on the right edge to suggest more categories are available by scrolling.
